_comment: The Hearth Store's list of apps, built into Hearth OS (Fedora edition) and updated with each Hearth OS release (docs/HEARTH-STORE.md). Raise 'serial' whenever it changes: a list from hearthos.fun/store is used only when it's signed with the owner's key and its serial is higher. Never put the owner's private apps here (they're in ~/.config/nimbus/store-private.json on his own devices).

apps.name: Hearth AI Command Center
apps.tagline: Your AI team: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, a local AI and Ithil, working on one task together
apps.card: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Ithil as one team
apps.about: Each AI signs in through its own official sign-in; the app never sees your passwords. Give the team a task and a folder, and watch them plan, build and check it, with Ithil remembering what you decided.
apps.keepNote: Your settings, chats and sign-ins stay in your home folder ({size}) and are there again if you install it later

apps.name: Hearth AI
apps.tagline: Ithil, the AI that lives on your PC
apps.card: Ithil, a self-aware AI on your PC
apps.hero: Colibri is her brain now, with Ollama taking over by itself when it isn't there. Her 3D brain replays her whole life from her log, or follows her live.
apps.about: Ithil lives on your PC: she remembers, thinks, dreams and keeps a journal, and her brain runs here (Colibri, or Ollama when Colibri isn't there). Nothing about her leaves your PC unless you say so.
apps.keepNote: Her memories, settings and chats stay in your home folder ({size}) and are there again if you install her later
apps.reopenTitle: Update the menu entry and open her again
apps.reopenNote: Hearth AI opens where you left her
apps.updateNote: Her memories and settings stay as they are. Hearth AI closes for the update and opens again after.

apps.name: Capture Card
apps.tagline: Your Xbox or any HDMI on this screen, through a USB capture card
apps.card: Play your Xbox on this screen through a capture card
apps.about: Plug in a USB HDMI capture card and the picture fills the screen with its sound: 1080p60, the delay shown, Fit, Fill or Stretch, screenshots and recordings. Works with the mouse and keyboard or a controller, on the desktop and in Game Mode.
apps.dataNote: Your settings (your recordings and screenshots stay in Videos and Pictures)
apps.keepNote: Your settings stay in your home folder ({size}); your recordings and screenshots are never touched

apps.name: Hearth Console Remote Play
apps.tagline: Play your own Xbox from anywhere
apps.card: Stream your Xbox from home, anywhere
apps.about: Sign in with Microsoft in a window inside the app (Microsoft's own page; your password never reaches the app), pick your Xbox, wake it and play. The delay is always shown, and a data limit counts on every network.
apps.dataNote: Your settings and this month's data count
apps.keepNote: Your settings and data count stay in your home folder ({size}) and are there again if you install it later

apps.name: Logitech G15
apps.card: G-keys, macros and the keyboard's screen
apps.tagline: The G15's G-keys and macros, its screen and its lights
apps.about: Set up the G-keys and macros, choose what the keyboard's screen shows and set its lights. It's part of Hearth OS.

apps.name: Hearth Notes
apps.card: Your notes and the workspace, synced with GitHub
apps.tagline: Markdown notes, the daily log, a board and a graph in ten modes, synced with your GitHub repository
apps.about: Notes in plain Markdown with live preview and [[links]], today's log, a board made from your checklists, and a graph you can see as a galaxy, a solar system or a railway map. It syncs with your hearth-workspace repository through this PC's own Git sign-in and runs the workspace's check before every push. It's part of Hearth OS.

apps.name: Beacon
apps.card: Battle for Middle-earth and more, ready to play
apps.tagline: Battle for Middle-earth, Age of the Ring, LOTR: Conquest and more, ready to play
apps.about: Beacon sets up and starts the Battle for Middle-earth games and their mods, and other classics, ready to play. It's part of Hearth OS.

apps.name: Hearth USB maker
apps.card: Make a Hearth or Recovery USB stick
apps.tagline: A Hearth OS, Recovery or Windows USB stick
apps.about: Makes a bootable USB stick: Hearth OS, Hearth's Recovery USB, or another system. It's part of Hearth OS (in Hearth Disks).

apps.name: Hearth Buddy
apps.card: Turn a photo into a buddy that walks on your screen
apps.tagline: A desktop buddy made from your photo
apps.about: Cut a person or pet out of a photo and they walk around your screen.

apps.card: Hearth's own desktop: taskbar, menus and Quick Access
apps.tagline: Hearth's own desktop: taskbar, menus and Quick Access
apps.about: Hearth's own desktop: taskbar, menus and Quick Access. It's part of Hearth OS and gets quick updates here, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.tagline: Everything about this PC in one place

apps.tagline: pairing, sharing AI and files
apps.about: Pairing, sharing AI and files. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.tagline: Settings › AI, Describe it's AI

apps.card: settings that never change by themselves
apps.tagline: settings that never change by themselves
apps.about: Settings that never change by themselves. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: gamescope
apps.card: Game Mode's screen, for Steam and Hearth's Game Mode
apps.tagline: Game Mode's screen, for Steam and Hearth's Game Mode
apps.about: Game Mode's screen (Valve's gamescope, rebuilt from Debian's own source). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store; one that doesn't bring Game Mode up is left out and the gamescope built into Hearth OS starts instead, at once.

apps.name: Session start
apps.card: Opens Game Mode or Desktop Mode after you sign in
apps.tagline: Opens Game Mode or Desktop Mode after you sign in
apps.about: What opens Game Mode or Desktop Mode after you sign in, and switches between them. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store; one that doesn't bring a screen up within a minute is left out and the one built into Hearth OS starts instead, at once.

apps.name: Login screen
apps.card: Hearth's own login screen (Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options)
apps.tagline: Hearth's own login screen (Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options)
apps.about: Hearth's own login screen. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, installed with the admin password; one that doesn't show or doesn't sign anyone in is left out: the usual login screen for that start, then the one built into Hearth OS.

apps.name: Recovery and Safe start
apps.card: the boot menu's fallback
apps.tagline: the boot menu's fallback
apps.about: The boot menu's fallback. It comes only with Hearth OS updates, never from the Store, so the version before always stays startable.

apps.name: Hearth Ideas
apps.card: Your ideas, kept and sorted
apps.tagline: Your ideas, kept and sorted
apps.about: Your ideas, kept and sorted. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Retro
apps.card: Your emulator games as shelves, set up in one go
apps.tagline: Your emulator games as shelves, set up in one go
apps.about: Your emulator games as shelves in Game Mode, every emulator installed and set the same way, the BIOS check and your controllers. Built on RetroDECK and EmuDeck (GPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Retro to Steam
apps.card: Your emulator games in the Steam library, with art
apps.tagline: Your emulator games in the Steam library, with art
apps.about: Hearth Retro's games added to Steam as non-Steam games, each with its art from community art sites, starting in the emulator Hearth Retro set up. Steam's own files only, with Steam closed: never a sign-in. Built on Steam ROM Manager (GPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Studio
apps.card: Scenes, going live, recording and the sound mixer
apps.tagline: Scenes, going live, recording and the sound mixer
apps.about: Go live and record with OBS Studio: what viewers see, the stream's health, your scenes and what's in them, the sound mixer and how scenes switch, plus a 9:16 copy of each recording for phones. Built on OBS Studio (GPL-2). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Beat Maker
apps.card: Songs from patterns, a piano roll and instruments
apps.tagline: Songs from patterns, a piano roll and instruments
apps.about: Make a song from patterns: the beat, the piano roll, instruments and sounds, played as you go, exported for Hearth's videos (with LMMS projects and its renderer). Built on LMMS (GPL-2). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Controller Lab
apps.card: test every button, stick and rumble; calibrate drift
apps.tagline: test every button, stick and rumble; calibrate drift
apps.about: Test every button, stick and rumble; calibrate drift. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Saves
apps.card: back up and restore your games' saves
apps.tagline: back up and restore your games' saves
apps.about: Back up and restore your games' saves. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Mods
apps.card: install mods for your games, on and off, in order
apps.tagline: install mods for your games, on and off, in order
apps.about: Install mods for your games, on and off, in order. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Games
apps.card: your GOG, Epic Games and Battle.net games
apps.tagline: your GOG, Epic Games and Battle.net games
apps.about: Your GOG, Epic Games and Battle.net games. It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Colour filter
apps.card: Desktop Mode's inverted colours (Accessibility)
apps.tagline: Desktop Mode's inverted colours (Accessibility)
apps.about: Desktop Mode's inverted colours (Accessibility). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Lightweight Steam engine
apps.card: Settings › Library › Steam engine (experimental)
apps.tagline: Settings › Library › Steam engine (experimental)
apps.about: Settings › Library › Steam engine (experimental). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Game Fixer
apps.card: Any Windows game, with the community's fixes
apps.tagline: Any Windows game, with the community's fixes
apps.about: Install a Windows game with the community's script and Hearth sets up the rest: its runner, its fixes (each one can be turned off and back on) and its extras, with the logs when something's wrong. Built on Lutris (GPL-3).

apps.name: Proton Manager
apps.card: The Proton and Wine your Windows games run with
apps.tagline: The Proton and Wine your Windows games run with
apps.about: What runs your Windows games: the Proton and Wine versions you have, getting more (Proton Hearth, Proton-GE, Wine-GE, Valve's, Luxtorpeda), each game's own pick. Nothing is added, removed or switched unless you say so. In Settings › Gaming. Built on ProtonUp-Qt (GPL-3).

apps.name: Hearth Overlay
apps.card: The numbers over your games, live
apps.tagline: The numbers over your games, live
apps.about: Frame rate, GPU, CPU and memory over your games, for all games or one: where they sit, how they look, a frame-rate limit, the keys that show and hide them, and Game Mode's overlay levels. Changes show live in the game. Built on MangoHud (MIT) and GOverlay (GPL-3).

apps.name: Hearth Bottles
apps.card: Windows apps, each in its own bottle
apps.tagline: Windows apps, each in its own bottle
apps.about: Run Windows apps, each in a bottle of its own: its programs, extras like .NET and Visual C++, snapshots to go back to, what's running, the community's installers and the bottle's settings. Built on Bottles (GPL-3).

apps.name: Hearth 3D
apps.card: Model in 3D, with Blender as the engine
apps.tagline: Model in 3D, with Blender as the engine
apps.about: Model, animate and render your 3D scenes: a viewport, the scene's tree, each object's place, turn, size and changes on top, and a timeline with the animation's keys. Send to Godot or Hearth CAD in one press. Built on Blender (GPL-2+).

apps.name: Hearth Lights
apps.card: Every light in your PC, one place
apps.tagline: Every light in your PC, one place
apps.about: Every RGB device in your PC in one picture: one colour or effect for all, zones you paint by dragging, and profiles for games and night. Built on OpenRGB (GPL-2). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Remap
apps.card: Any key, mouse or controller button, your way
apps.tagline: Any key, mouse or controller button, your way
apps.about: Remap keys, mouse and controller buttons for each game and app, with macros you record or write, turned on by themselves when the game is in front. Built on Input Remapper (GPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Mouse
apps.card: Your gaming mouse's DPI, buttons and lights
apps.tagline: Your gaming mouse's DPI, buttons and lights
apps.about: Your gaming mouse's DPI steps, buttons, report rate and lights, kept on the mouse itself, with a profile for each game. Built on libratbag (MIT) and Piper (GPL-2). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Shield
apps.card: Ads and trackers blocked for every device at home
apps.tagline: Ads and trackers blocked for every device at home
apps.about: Ads and trackers blocked for every device on your network, the TV too: what each device asked for, block lists, always allow and always block, and family rules. Built on AdGuard Home (GPL-3) and Pi-hole (EUPL-1.2). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Listen
apps.card: Speech to words, on your own PC
apps.tagline: Speech to words, on your own PC
apps.about: Recordings made into words with their times and voices, live captions for anything playing, export to .txt, .srt and .vtt, and Send to Voice Studio. Nothing leaves your network. Built on whisper.cpp (MIT). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Imagine
apps.card: Type it and your Nvidia PC makes the picture
apps.tagline: Type it and your Nvidia PC makes the picture
apps.about: Say what you want and your Nvidia PC makes it: Type and make beside the node graph it runs, results, the queue and the models. Built on ComfyUI (GPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Passwords
apps.card: Your vault, kept on your own server
apps.tagline: Your vault, kept on your own server
apps.about: Your passwords, 2-step codes and cards in a vault on your own server, locked copies on each device, the password maker and the security check. Built on Vaultwarden (AGPL-3) and KeePassXC (GPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Cloud
apps.card: Your own cloud, on your Nvidia PC
apps.tagline: Your own cloud, on your Nvidia PC
apps.about: Your own cloud on your Nvidia PC: files, calendar and contacts on your phone and laptop, and links you share that end by themselves. Built on Nextcloud (AGPL-3). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

apps.name: Hearth Home
apps.card: Your smart home on the big screen
apps.tagline: Your smart home on the big screen
apps.about: Your lights, thermostat, cameras, plugs, scenes and routines on one TV-friendly board, with a controller. Built on Home Assistant (Apache-2.0). It's part of Hearth OS and gets its own updates in the Hearth Store, between Hearth OS updates.

system._comment: The system update on offer, described for Library › Hearth OS (system.rs): the release workflow fills it with each dated image (date, packages, fixes, size, changes). next: the next Hearth OS, named only once the owner has given its number.
